concepts.def: Discrete: countable outcomes (binomial, Poisson). Continuous: any value in an interval (normal, exponential).
PMF p(x) gives P(X = x) for discrete X. Σp(x) = 1. Used to define distribution.
PDF f(x) for continuous X. P(a ≤ X ≤ b) = ∫ₐᵇ f(x) dx. Total area under curve = 1.
E(X) = Σx·p(x) (discrete) or ∫x·f(x) dx (continuous). Long-run average value.
Var(X) = E(X²) − [E(X)]². Spread of distribution. SD = √Var(X).
E(aX + b) = aE(X) + b; Var(aX + b) = a²Var(X). For independent X, Y: Var(X+Y) = Var(X) + Var(Y).

walkthroughs.body_html:
Statistical Sampling — a core area of A-Level Maths.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Statistical Sampling brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Statistical Sampling.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between area and perimeter?
options: It is reflected in the y-axis because of the minus.
Area and perimeter are different names for the same measurement.
Area is half the perimeter for any shape.
Perimeter is the total distance around the outside; area is the amount of surface inside (measured in square units).

mcqs.q: How does the graph of y = f(x - 3) compare to y = f(x)?
options: It is reflected in the y-axis because of the minus.
It is translated 3 units to the left because of the minus.
Area is half the perimeter for any shape.
It is translated 3 units to the right.

mcqs.q: In Pythagoras' theorem, which side does c^2 represent?
options: It is reflected in the y-axis because of the minus.
c^2 represents any side of the triangle as long as the other two are squared.
The hypotenuse — the longest side, opposite the right angle.
c^2 represents the side opposite the largest angle that is not 90 degrees.
